Test median on pool4 as a robust alternative to trimmed_mean (leader) given unstable ranking.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7918. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.5542; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.072); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.632.
